title: Bound the page size for a synthetic catalog endpoint

outcome.problem: Large page requests can consume excessive resources.
outcome.intended_effect: Predictable page bounds for approved clients.
outcome.baseline: Synthetic scenario; no production baseline has been measured.

in_scope: Update behavior documentation and focused tests.

risk.rationale: Illustrative reversible parameter validation without production access.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given an integer page_size from 1 through 100, preserve that value.
Given an out-of-range or non-integer page_size, return HTTP 400 with error code INVALID_PAGE_SIZE.

verification.required_independence: Results must be inspectable independently of the implementer narrative.

assumptions: The synthetic scenario assumes clients can use the specified validation response.

observation.measure: Observe invalid-request behavior and resource impact after a separately authorized release.
observation.failure_response: Open a corrective mission and evaluate a safe revert.
